summary: Aisha Johnson and Ravi Gupta met with Kendra Wallace and SecOps lead Owen Pritchard of Brightpath Commerce for the technical session promised ahead of Brightpath's mid-May vendor decision. Kendra disclosed that SentinelShield currently leads their evaluation on pipeline visibility and a 99.9% SLA. Ravi explained the post-outage architecture (active-active nodes, circuit breaker, ~12-second failover with no event loss) and an upcoming in-console pipeline health panel with PagerDuty heartbeat alerts. Owen described severe alert fatigue (~180 alerts/day, ~15 actionable), and Ravi proposed a re-baseline, suppression windows and entity-level thresholds, to be proven on Brightpath's own April data in a sandbox. Aisha offered an enhanced 99.9% Detect SLA with a March service credit, and Kendra signalled the renewal becomes much easier if commitments are written and tuning results hold.
